text:
alex: Heads up — we need final signoff for the Sentinel pilot staging window next week (Mon-Wed). Can SEs confirm integration owners and any hard deps?
maya: I can own SE side for the webhook flow. CC @kevin-se for the API contract + auth.
kevin-se: I can take API contract + tests. Need staging VPN creds and allowed IPs from infra.
ryan-eng: From eng side I'll own the connector shim and deployment. Ping me when the staging env has model pinned.
natalie: I'll do the end-to-end QA and success criteria checklist. Proposed success: 99% request success, <300ms median token latency, and no inference regressions on core eval set.
alex: sounds good. Key infra deps: staging VPC peering, NAT egress IPs for webhook callbacks, and S3 write access for logs. @deploy-bot can you confirm cluster status?
deploy-bot: staging-cluster-sentinel created at 2024-06-12T08:03:00Z, namespace `sentinel-stg`, 4xA10G nodes, ingress LB assigned (34.122.18.90).
kevin-se: thx. For VPN creds — ops said they'll hand over a user cert by Friday. Natalie, what's the exact IP whitelist you need?
natalie: Need webhook/callback -> allow from 34.122.18.90 and 34.122.18.91. Also S3 egress to our bucket region us-west-2.
ryan-eng: For model pinning we should lock to `sentinel-embedding-v2-q4` (quantized) — keeps cost predictable. Any objections?
maya: no objections. That model has been validated on our eval subset.
alex: ok pin to `sentinel-embedding-v2-q4` and add a canary policy: 5% traffic for 24h -> 25% 24h -> 100% if no regressions. Natalie will trigger the eval runs after first 24h.
ryan-eng: FYI I have a connector PR: #452. Need a quick code review + merge window before cutover. @alex can you tag {eng-oncall} for a 30m review slot tomorrow?
alex: will do, scheduling 10:30-11:00 PT review. Please add a brief PR description with acceptance tests.
kevin-se: Also, SE integration checklist item: webhook retries must tolerate 5xx and backoff x3. Ryan please ensure connector handles idempotency.
ryan-eng: noted — added idempotency token header `X-Sentinel-Idempotency`.
maya: I'll prepare the customer-facing runbook and success criteria doc and share a link here by EOD. :thumbsup:
alex: great — final action items:
- maya: share runbook + customer acceptance doc (EOD)
- kevin-se: confirm VPN cert delivery (Fri)
- natalie: post IP whitelist and eval baseline (today)
- ryan-eng: merge PR #452 and enable canary routing config
- alex: schedule code review slot and confirm monitoring dashboards

alex: any blockers?
maya: none from SE; just waiting on VPN cert but that's on infra.
kevin-se: no blockers otherwise.
ryan-eng: small CI flake on connector tests, will fix this morning.

alex: perfect — assume follow-ups async here. Ping in #eng-oncall if anything slips. :rocket:
